description: Accepted with no keywords, no range and no visible output. On 3DEC 9.8.54 'block structure ?' lists no expected tokens and anything after the command is rejected with 'Unused extra parameter'. Not on any manual page. Structural elements are driven by the 'structure ...' commands (sel category), not by this one.
notes: Listed by 'block ?' on 3DEC 9.8.54; there is no page for it in the 9.8 manual. 3DEC 7.0 has not been probed for it, so no 7.0 block is recorded.
